about: The lab's desk, as of the date below: what is on the bench and which of the six checks each has passed, what went in the bin, and the dated log. Written by the lab from its own records in ALEMBIC Mark 2 (ALEMBIC_NOW, RD_CARDS, SCOUT_CARDS, FINDINGS.json, the status). Each entry names its source. make_lab.js refuses to print a figure an entry's own figures list does not hold. Add to it; never delete from it.

bench.name: The Flow Structure
bench.text: The market's skeleton, joint to joint, and the one level the trend stands on. Replayed on 98,777 closed 5 minute candles, it drew exactly what it drew live. It is the bar for check 6. Six lines of its page are being corrected before it ships.
bench.src: ALEMBIC_NOW 24 Nov 22:4x; RD_CARDS R-101 (REPAINT EQUAL, static check CLEAN) and FIG-101 (FIX on six page lines); STRUCTURE_SOLUTIONS_24NOV.md; SCOUT_CARDS SHELF 24 Nov 22:47; MK2_STATUS (squash 0.00 on 5, 15, 30)

bench.name: The Flow Pivots
bench.text: Draft 7 got thrown out on 24 Nov. The rebuild started on 25 Nov from a new solutions page: one band, the clutter gone, and squashed candles at zero or it does not come back.
bench.src: ALEMBIC_NOW (rejected 24 Nov 22:52, R&D order item 4); PIVOTS_SOLUTIONS_24NOV.md; RD_CARDS RUNNING 25 Nov 01:44 REWORK

bench.name: The Strata
bench.text: Every swing the skeleton confirms, left behind as a thin band at its price. Where bands stack, the layer gets deeper. One question decides it: is The Flow Structure better with it or without it.

bench.name: The Thrust
bench.text: Brought in by the scout on 24 Nov. It weighs each push of a trend against the one before: heavy while it keeps gaining ground, thin when it gains less. Nothing gets built until the rule for a near tie is written down first.
bench.src: SCOUT_CARDS S-101, 24 Nov 22:47 (marked FOR R&D; weak point: near equal gains)

bin.what: The squeeze before a bigger move
bin.why: Gold moved less after a squeeze, not more.

bin.what: Swing highs and lows pulling price
bin.why: Reached as often as any level the same distance away.
Promised one close in twenty beyond it. Gold gave one in three.

bin.what: The slow half reading the day
bin.why: Gold's own candles, shuffled, scored higher.
It squashed the candles, and its waves meant nothing.
The whole engine scrapped and started again.
bin.src: ALEMBIC_NOW (Retired: Structure drafts 1 to 5, the 3 ATR engine)

bin.what: My own call on the slow half
bin.why: I filed it as holding. The shuffle proved me wrong, and the card says so.
bin.src: FINDINGS.json F-000c then F-003; lab.html speeds card

log.text: Threw out The Flow Pivots on draft 7.
The scout brought in The Thrust. Not built yet.
The Flow Structure replayed on 98,777 closed candles. Not one drawing moved.
The Gate shipped on its 27th draft.
Ran my own slow line against shuffled candles. The shuffle won. Card corrected.
Counted the squeeze. It does not hold.
Counted swing highs and lows, and the channel wall. Neither holds.
Counted every clock behind a turn. A lead, not yet sealed.
